date_policy.start_selection: New future UTC-midnight start after engineering review, official source/fee/rate verification, independent acceptance and explicit study approval; no backfill
date_policy.release_rule: At least two days after collection end, with fresh official settlement rechecks and all outcomes resolved; never automatic date shifts
date_policy.date_rationale: After the public sealed study002 release boundary 2026-12-12; no access to that study results is authorized or needed. No overlap/cohort reuse, no automatic shift.
date_policy.missed_deadline: Do not start. Propose and separately review future dates and package hash; never modify sealed/current study dates.

frozen_design.primary_strategy_selection: Proposed before collection; no selection based on study002 outcomes. A changed primary needs a separately reviewed protocol before any new data is collected.

acceptance.stress_daily_lower_bound: strictly > 0 for all predeclared block lengths
acceptance.paired_zero_minus_market_brier_upper_bou: strictly < 0 for all predeclared block lengths

cost_policy.stress_scenario: Preserve current conservative fragmentation bounds and predeclared slippage reserves. No weakening after results.
cost_policy.required_evidence: Independent official current KXBTC15M fee/multiplier, fill quantum, account precision and applicable read cost/rate verification; no account mutations or authenticated test launch in this proposal
cost_policy.feasibility_status: BLOCKED: .01 fill-quantum, cent-precision, no-rebate worst-case all-in bound is at least $1.005 for a fully positive-price one-contract fill with .5c reserve. Stress example $1.015. Maximum payout $1; positive stress acceptance cannot pass under this bound.
cost_policy.change_control: Preserve this unfavorable bound and current acceptance thresholds. Any evidence-supported fee-model revision must be independently reviewed and frozen in a new proposal/source hash before collection; never revise based on outcomes.

persistence_policy.confirmation: Only previously completed observation with matching digest, logged state and committed completion marker, healthy source provenance and a newer source sample may confirm
persistence_policy.authorities: Study database transactions and unique slot/signal keys; observation JSONL diagnostic only
persistence_policy.duplicate_policy: Exact repeated state observation idempotent; conflicting same-time payload/reversed clock rejected; study clock read/check/write serialized
persistence_policy.crash_policy: Any uncommitted new observation stays nonconfirming across restart. Gaps/missing execution windows are retained, not backfilled or imputed. Pending diagnostics may duplicate after crash; never substitute them for authoritative outcomes.
persistence_policy.remaining_gate: Demonstrate separately reviewed machine power-loss, reboot/clock continuity, retention/disk-capacity and interrupted-publication recovery policy before activation

holdout_policy.result_access: Separate evaluator and access controls; no analyst holdout queries before approved release

approval_gates: All engineering blockers addressed or explicitly reviewed with bounded operating scope
Successful independent acceptance review; Reasonix timeout/partial output is not sign-off
New source/protocol/dependency and configuration hashes archived together
Separate manifest-bound evidence-only approval before proposed start
No approval inheritance or modification of study002 sealed release
Prepare a separately reviewed research release; do not remove the offline candidate guard as an adoption shortcut

comparisons.confirmatory: drift_free forecast versus executable-cost-independent market midpoint forecast on the same first healthy checkpoint; always-abstain is zero trading-return baseline
comparisons.rules: No primary reselection, threshold tuning, regime cherry-picking, alternate missing-day denominator or promotion from exploratory arm results.

operating_plan.market: Public-source KXBTC15M binary-contract observations only; future evidence collector not implemented/activated by this package
operating_plan.external_requests: GET only via separately approved read-only release; no portfolio/positions/fills or trading credentials needed for evidence collection unless a separately authorized fee-attestation task is later specified
operating_plan.storage: Fresh version-bound databases/controlled 0700 directory; no reuse/migration of study002 or original runtime; logical pending/commit completion markers; SQLite authoritative study state
operating_plan.publication: NO TRADE JSON is analytical UI transport, not action authority; text is diagnostic only. Both must match epoch/digest before a consumer treats them as one observation; mismatch causes degraded state and operator review. No automation consumes text as a trade instruction.
operating_plan.duplicate_diagnostics: Group by _observation_digest; count distinct authoritative observations, never physical JSONL rows. Append-before-marker crash may create duplicate diagnostic lines.
operating_plan.recovery: Uncommitted last observation remains nonconfirming. Preserve partial records and gap evidence. Do not backfill execution quotes or overwrite pending exposure. Do not replay same-epoch study writes after an uncertain commit; inspect read-only and require reviewed repair/new protocol if continuity cannot be proven.
operating_plan.clock: Persisted wall/monotonic continuity gate is unchanged. Reboot or wall-only suspend discontinuity halts. No automatic monotonic reset or silent restart cohort. An approved cold-start/reboot recovery design remains required before release activation.
operating_plan.retention: Existing replay observation retention applies only to audit observations/gaps. Keep implementations and all frozen checkpoints/outcomes through separately reviewed release/retention horizon; no automatic deletion or log rotation is added.
operating_plan.capacity: Capacity planning below is proposal-only; no runtime capacity monitor or quota enforcement is implemented. This is an activation blocker, not an approved operating safeguard.

stop_conditions: Any attempted order/account mutation, non-GET market request, enabled public directional advice or enabled management
Stale/future/incomplete source, identity ambiguity or unread pagination: abstain and record degraded state; missing required checkpoints/windows block favorable review
Uncertain/partial database commit, inconsistent publication or corrupted state: halt collector, preserve evidence, no automatic repair/backfill
UTC/monotonic discontinuity or reboot/suspend reset: halt; no silent clock reset
Disk/quota/IO error or unavailable storage/capacity monitoring: halt; retain pending/unconfirmed state; do not prune authoritative evidence to resume
Venue fee/rate rules cannot be verified or current profitability bound remains mathematically incompatible with acceptance: no profitability-validation activation
Approval deadline missed: no start and no automatic date changes
gates_still_open: Bounded independent review obtained for recovery tests and blocked status; complete release/operations acceptance still required
Boot/suspend recovery and trustworthy clock operating assumptions
Measured capacity, retention enforcement and disk/IO stop mechanism
Evidence-supported fee/execution model feasibility under unchanged acceptance thresholds
Current source/fee/rate/read-only credential or entitlement attestations as applicable
Separate executable new-study validator and release deployment plan; inherited study002 validator rejects this proposal
Explicit package/manifest-bound evidence-only approval, future dates and destination; QA approval is not study approval

required_future_approval_scope.action: Evidence-only prospective collection on a separately reviewed new release, not this disabled candidate
must_identify: absolute approved new release/runtime directory and source/config/dependency/protocol/package hashes
final future UTC dates and approval timestamp before deadline
approved read-only sources, request cadence/pacing/quota and storage/recovery limits
holdout access boundary, custodian/release policy and stop authority
must_explicitly_exclude: Approval inheritance, modification of sealed study002 or protected outcome reuse
Automatic repair, restart, schedule creation or promotion outside approved scope
